items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Expands Neuroscience Push With Multi Year AI Alliance
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) has entered a multi-year collaboration with Pathos AI and Tempus AI focused on neuroscience. The alliance aims to build an AI-driven dataset and analytical toolkit targeting Alzheimer's disease and other neurological conditions. Partners plan to integrate large-scale patient information with AI-powered hypothesis testing to support precision medicine and trial design.
